description: Generate code coverage reports with gcc/gcov

latest_release.body:
New features and notable changes:

- Change the breadcrumbs of in the source view of the GitHub theme. (#1328)

Bug fixes and small improvements:

- Fix removing coverage for internal functions in C sources. (#1320)
- Fix release pipeline to upload standalone applications for MacOs again. (#1321)

Internal changes:

- Add zizmor to scan pipeline for security issues. (#1318)
- Add dependabot configuration for version updates. (#1325)
- Change exclusion handling to use a data class instead of simple integers. (#1326)
- Add nox session to cleanup duplicate reference data and notify session after import. (#1327)
